title: Beyond a Single Sentiment Score: Topical and Affective Dimensions of Emoji Meaning on Twitter
abstract: arXiv:2610.28337v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Emoji are widely treated as compact affective tokens whose meaning is summarised by a single sentiment score. We argue that this picture is incomplete. From a corpus of 16{,}575 English tweets and a per-emoji metric we call \emph{stability delta} (within-class minus between-class cosine similarity of sentence embeddings), we show that emojis used in tightly clustered topical contexts also exhibit \emph{more} polarised crowd-sourced sentiment, not less. Validated against the Kralj Novak et al.\ (2015) sentiment lexicon, the central correlation is Spearman $\rho = +0.361$ (Holm $p = 0.015$, 95\% bootstrap CI $[+0.10, +0.59]$); against the independent Ferr\'{e} et al.\ (2025) Spanish 13-emotion ratings, $\rho = +0.509$ ($p = 0.0003$). The result survives permutation testing, BCa bootstrap, leave-one-out jackknife, partial correlation controlling for emoji frequency, and Holm correction across a four-test family. Topical coherence and affe

translated_title: 超越单一情感分数：Twitter上表情符号意义的主题与情感维度
translated_abstract: 表情符号通常被视作紧凑的情感符号，其意义由单一情感分数来概括。我们认为这种看法并不完整。基于一个包含16,575条英文推文的语料库，以及我们提出的针对每个表情符号的度量指标——“稳定性差值”（stability delta，即句子嵌入的类内余弦相似度减去类间余弦相似度），我们发现在主题高度聚集的语境中使用的表情符号，其众包情感反而更加两极化，而非更弱。以Kralj Novak等人（2015）的情感词典进行验证，核心相关性为Spearman ρ = +0.361（Holm校正后p = 0.015，95%自助法置信区间[+0.10, +0.59]）；以独立的Ferré等人（2025）西班牙语13种情感评分为参照，ρ = +0.509（p = 0.0003）。该结果通过了置换检验、BCa自助法、留一法折刀检验、控制表情符号使用频率的偏相关分析，以及跨四项检验族的Holm校正。主题凝聚性与情感……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 研究发现，在Twitter上主题语境越聚集的表情符号，其众包情感分数反而越两极化，表明表情符号的意义无法用单一情感分数概括，需要同时考虑主题与情感两个维度。
en_tdlr: Emojis used in tightly clustered topical contexts exhibit more polarized crowd-sourced sentiment, demonstrating that emoji meaning on Twitter cannot be captured by a single sentiment score alone and requires both topical and affective dimensions.
